lines.reason: Plate (skin 2) to flange (skin 4), about 90 deg. In my own sections at 25/50/75% the label point sits on the outer arc crest to within 0.01-0.04 mm, with the inner skin about 2.4 mm below (t=2.45). The line is parallel to the fold and spans the full fold: zone points run t=-0.55..58.7 mm against a line length of 58.4 mm. Checked by eye in 12 global views and 2 close-ups.
